Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 recert: evidence window & retention ask

Kimberly —

Quick note as we prepare for FinCap's SOC 2 recertification: our audit team is asking that log retention for hosted inference telemetry be extended from the current 24 months to 36 months for FY27 recert. Can you confirm whether Redwood can support a 36-month retention window for the audit evidence bundle?

We'd also like to understand operational impact: will this require an amendment to our agreement, and what would be the likely cost / capacity implications if we also increase ingestion during the audit sprint? We're considering a short-term 20–30% burst commitment during evidence transfer to avoid rate limits.

Please point me to the evidence index and a quick plan for an orderly handoff by the week of Aug 8–12. Our audit lead prefers the evidence to arrive in staged batches rather than a single bulk drop.

Thanks —
Megan Ortiz
Head of Security, FinCap Financial
m.ortiz@fincap.com
+1 415-555-0198

Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert: evidence window & retention ask

Megan —

Thanks for the heads up. Short answer: we can support 36 months of retention for audited logs. There are two parallel items to coordinate: (1) a contract amendment to extend the retention SLA and (2) a capacity/onramp plan if you elect to temporarily increase ingestion during the handoff.

Plan proposal (high level):
- Evidence: we'll produce a staged export (week-of Aug 8) with a daily cadence for the first 3 days, then a final bulk snapshot. See proposed folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSOC2-evidence
- Retention: amend schedule to 36 months; will add a small per-GB retention premium to cover storage + retrieval costs (estimate to follow).
- Capacity: temporary dedicated burst capacity for the export window; suggest a 20% baseline uplift and the option to scale to 30% for one week if needed.

I've looped in Rishi and Marcus to model pricing and any infra caveats. Rishi — can you run a quick delta on storage + throughput charges and flag any SLA changes? Marcus — can you confirm export mechanics and whether staged exports create any additional partial-availability risk?

I will prepare a short amendment draft and a suggested evidence handoff checklist; sending a version of both by tomorrow EOD.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Team —

Following FinCap's ask (see below), I sketched a working change-set that we'll use to brief legal and draft an amendment. Noting some constraints and requests:

1) Retention change: 24 -> 36 months for audit logs (applies to token-level telemetry + routing traces). This is additive to any existing 'log custody' carveouts for escrow.
2) Evidence delivery: staged export over Aug 8–10 with final snapshot on Aug 11. Audit wants daily batches for sampling.
3) Capacity: FinCap is open to a 20% uplift; they signaled potential to move to 30% if needed. This would be a short 7–10 day commitment.

Immediate asks for this afternoon:
- Rishi: storage + retrieval delta (per GB delta + flat amendment fee). Add a 'burst' surcharge model for 7–10 day window.
- Marcus: write a short ops runbook for staged export (include IAM scoping, transfer method, checksums, and expected export size). Call out if any export will temporarily increase CPU/GPU scheduling contention.
- Priyom: pricing/legal — can we offer a one-page amendment with a 12-mo commitment add-on and a 15–20% discount on the retention premium if they commit to 12 months? If yes, prepare a draft clause we can attach.

Attachments: retention-change-diff.docx (stub), capacity-impact-estimate.xlsx (stub)

I'll stitch together responses and share the amendment draft tomorrow morning for internal review.

Kim

Kim —

Quick numbers from infra/finance:
- Storage delta (24 -> 36 months): ~0.015 USD/GB/month additional on archival tier. For current FinCap footprint (~5TB of relevant telemetry) that's ~68 USD/month incremental.
- Retrieval egress/processing for staged export: estimate one-time 420 USD for the 3-stage export (checksums, manifests, rehydration).
- Burst capacity uplift (20% for 10 days): estimate operational surcharge ~1,200 USD (covers preemptible capacity scheduling & priority).

Suggested commercial approach: add a retention premium line item and offer a 12-month committed addendum with a 15% credit on the retention premium if they sign within 14 days. Include a one-time export fee as above.

Attaching a simple workbook I used: capacity-impact-estimate.xlsx (stub)
